answer: Rewards are weighted by a decaying plume of historical uptime, so a swarm of fresh sybils earns nearly zero until it survives many epochs, making each fake reputation slot cost more than it returns. Each agent must stake a unique proof-of-work crystal bound to its hardware, and every epoch it solves a fresh challenge whose difficulty sits right on the profitability ledge: honest mining costs less than faking identities. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
